Sri Lanka got the early breakthrough but then got frustrated, first via the Saha-Pandya partnership and then by the ongoing Saha-Jadeja stand. The hosts are already behind in this Test and if they don't scalp the last few wickets quickly, they are in for a drubbing. Declaration would be one question on everyone's mind. Ashwin prods forward to defend but gets it off the inside edge on the leg side.
Full outside off, driven straight down. Perera dives to his left and makes the stop.
Served around middle, spinning into the pads, tapped to short leg.

Well adjusted! Rahane advances down the track, Perera spots that and drags his length back. Drops it short but Rahane still goes through with his heave like pull. The ball goes on a couple of bounces to deep mid-wicket for a single.

Another delivery full and outside off, placed to point.
FOUR!  Square driven! Sprayed full but wide outside off, Ashwin extends his arms and smashes it through point. There's a big gap there and a boundary is collected.
Sliding into the batsman, driven to mid on.
Loopy delivery outside off, spinning away, pushed with the spin to covers for a single.

Rahane dances down the track, stays leg sidish and defends it on the leg side.
Spinning down leg, tapped to short leg.
Tossed up outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
Fuller on the stumps, Ash leans ahead and blocks it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
No ball! Rahane uses his feet, dances down and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single. Perera has overstepped here, second time in the match.
On middle, spinning in, tapped to short leg.
Full on middle and leg, Rahane clips it off the front foot through mid-wicket for a run.
Driven through covers for a single.
There are clouds hovering on top. The groundsmen are getting ready. Not good signs these!
Served fuller outside off, milked down to long off for a single.
Loopy delivery on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Tossed up outside off, Rahane leans into the drive and gets it through covers for a brace.
Slower through the air outside off, spinning away, Rahane leans forward and places it to point.
Malinda Puhspakumara comes into the attack for the first time in the day.

DRINKS BREAK! Dimuth Karunaratne provided the vital breakthrough removing Pujara but then failed to capitalize on it. Since then Rahane and Ashwin have gelled along well and are amidst an useful partnership. The hosts will have to scalp some quick wickets to get back into the game.
50-run stand is up between Rahane and Ashwin!
Flicks it with the spin through mid-wicket for a run.
Bowls it outside off, Ajinkya guides it through point for a couple. This is Rahane's highest score against Sri Lanka in all formats of the game.
Quicker outside off, Ashwin guides it down to third man. Mathews from slip hares after it and keeps it down to three.
Flatter outside off, Ashwin lets it through to the keeper.
Works it with the spin to mid-wicket.
Dances down the track and drives it to mid on for a run.
Sprays on the pads, Rahane flicks it through square leg to retain strike in the next over.
Loopy ball on off, Ashwin drives it through covers and changes strike.
Gives it air on middle, Rahane drives it beautifully through mid off for a run.
Tosses it up on middle, Rahane lunges forward and defends it.

FOUR! Easy peasy! Short and outside off, Ashwin cuts it through cover-point for a boundary. That was a nothing ball form Rangana.

Works it with the spin to mid on.

The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
BEATEN! Lovely stuff from Dilruwan. The previous ball turned, this one went on with the arm. Ashwin plays for the turn but gets beaten.
Bowls it on off, gets some sharp turn into the batsman. Rahane flicks it towards fine leg for a run.

Dickwella straightaway asks the captain to review and Chandimal obliges. They go upstairs. The replays show there is no inside edge and Hawk Eye shows three reds. The decision has to be overturned. Pujara has to depart after playing a fine, fine knock. The 217-run partnership has been broken. Karunaratne gets his first Test wicket. Can Sri Lanka now build on this?

PITCH REPORT - Russel Arnold feels the pitch still looks the same and runs are on offer. He mentions there is sharp turn from the good length area in the line of the stumps. Admits this pitch is slower than the pitch in Galle. He ends by saying today and tomorrow will be the best days for batting.

Hello and a warm welcome to the second day of this second Test between Sri Lanka and India. The visitors have once again ruled the roost and pushed the home side very much on the back foot. They will now hope that the pair of Cheteshwar Pujara and Ajinkya Rahane add to their overnight total and take the game out of the hosts' hand. The Islanders will have to trigger a collapse for hopes of making a comeback. Stay tuned for the proceedings, weather permitting as rains are predicted throughout the day...
... Day 2, Session 1 ...

India tomorrow will try and bat Sri Lanka out of the game, whereas the Lankans will need a few early wickets to get back into the game. Do join us for all the action from the 2nd day of the Test at 1000 local (0430 GMT). Till then, cheers and take care!

Sri Lanka on the other hand, have found it very difficult to apply any kind of pressure on the Indian batsmen. They were too short and bowled way too many bad balls. To make matters worse, Nuwan Pradeep walked off holding a hamstring and if he cannot bowl tomorrow, it is going to be a crucial blow for the hosts.

Rahane and Pujara walk off to a standing ovation from the dressing room. A hundred from both of them has ensured India are right on top in this match. They did not lose a wicket in this session and have managed to add 106 runs. After winning the toss and opting to bat this the ideal situation they would have wanted to be in. Earlier in the day, Rahul scored a brisk fifty and Dhawan and Kohli were lost cheaply, but it evidently didn't matter as the Pujara-Rahane partnership covered for it very well.
Last ball of the day. Full and around off, Pujara walks across the sticks and whips it through mid-wicket. The fielder chases it down as the batsmen come back for the second. STUMPS ON DAY 1!
Decent amount of bounce for Herath, Pujara does well to deal with the extra bounce.

Pitched just back of a driving length, on middle and off, Pujara is quite far down the track to play but is caught on the pads. Muted appeal, the umpire declines. Maybe Sri Lanka should have reviewed that. It looked to be hitting in line and with the technology available today, they could have had the decision go their way.

He did get a big inside edge before the ball hit the pad and so, he's safe. Not sure how the umpire missed that to be honest.
Instant review from Rahane. He's caught leg before and given out. Indicates there's an inside edge and is very confident of it. It's taken upstairs.
Drives this full delivery straight to short extra cover.

Gets back and defends it down on the off side.
Use of the feet again from Che, finds mid on again. Plays it along the carpet straight to the fielder.

On a driveable length, inviting Rahane forward. He accepts it but only blocks.

9th Test hundred for Ajinkya Rahane!

Fifty for Rahane! Has been flawless so far. Scored runs briskly and looked brilliant. Drives it to long off and takes a single. Like Pujara, he too must carry on and make a big score.

Comes down the track and flicks it to deep square leg for a run.
NO BALL! Bowls it on the pads, Pujara flicks it through square leg for a couple. Perera has overstepped there.
Works it around the corner for a run.
FOUR! POOR LENGTH! Short on middle, Rahane won't miss out on that. He camps back and pulls it through square leg for a boundary.

Uses his feet and drives the ball down to long off for a run.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

Dances down the track and mistimes his shot to mid on.

Quciker on middle, Pujara defends it off the back foot.

Sri Lanka on the other hand, have been wayward with their lines and lengths. They need a quick wicket or two post tea to get back into the game. There is assistance from the pitch but the Lankan bowlers are not hitting the right areas. They need to come out fighting after the break. Join us for the final session in a short while.

This session 30 overs, 137 runs and 2 wickets. Sri Lanka started off the session well by taking two quick wickets but Rahane and Pujara added some quick runs and have made sure that it has belonged to India. Pujara has been like a wall at one end while Rahane is scoring at a brisk rate. The visitors will want the same to continue after the break.
Good length ball on off, Rahane blocks it back down the track. TEA ON DAY 1!
Short again, this time Rahane pulls it away. Along the ground through backward square leg as he'll get two runs.
Sharp bumper on middle and off, Rahane crouches low and lets the ball sail over his head.

Not out! The on-field calls stays! Poor review in hindsight, to be honest. Looked to be safe in real time itself. Length delivery jagging back in from outside off, Rahane plants his front foot across to block but is caught on the front pad. Loud appeal and the umpire says no. Chandimal talks with his teammates and decides to review it. Replays show that the impact is outside the line of off stump and so that's that.
There is a review for an lbw decision against Ajinkya Rahane. Impact looks outside off. Over to the third umpire now...
Shaping back in from around off, on a length, Rahane punches it straight back in the direction of the bowler.
Angling in on middle and leg, Pujara picks it off his pads and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Eased away through towards sweeper cover for a single.
Punched away past the extra cover fielder and a run is taken.
The batsman defends it from within the crease, pushing the ball on the off side.
Drifting in once again, around off, Rahane from his front foot meets it with the full face.
Drifting in on off, blocked off the front foot.
100-run stand between Rahane and Pujara. It has come in quick time, just 104 balls.
Slider on middle and off, Pujara backs away and punches it through covers for a run.
Rangana Herath returns to the attack. He will have a change of ends.
Straying on the pads, comfortably worked through square leg. Two runs are taken as the fielder out in the deep cuts it off.
Outside off on a good length, steered to point all along the ground.
Poor line from Pradeep, is lucky though as it isn't put away. On the pads, Rahane looks to clip but it goes off his pads to fine leg as the batsmen take a leg bye.
Just back of a length, outside the line of off stump, gets behind the line by moving a step across and blocks it down on the track.
Cutting back in on a shortish length, Rahane swivels and pulls it along the ground through backward square leg. A brace has been taken.
Tap and run! Che drops this with soft hands square on the off side and both batsmen cross over.
Nuwan Pradeep comes back into the attack.
Uses his feet once more, to the pitch and wrists it through mid-wicket. Single taken.
Flicked with the wrists through the vacant spaces in the mid-wicket area. One run taken.
Moves forward and leans across as he blocks it out.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Short ball, backs away a little and offers a punch straight to short extra cover.
Off break delivery on off, coming in, Rahane presses ahead and blocks just as the ball starts to turn.
FOUR! Boundary to end the over. Dropped short, ample amount of time for Pujara to go back and slap it past the diving extra cover fielder. Picked his spot and executed the placement to perfection.
Milked down to long off for an easy one.
Spinning away from outside off, with an open face Che pushes it through backward point for a single.
Stays right behind the line and negotiates the spin easily.
FOUR! Poor ball to bowl, especially with third man up in the circle. Short and wide, Pujara cuts it away across the boundary line.
Slow drift on middle and off, full in length, Pujara brings down a straight blade in defense.
Rangana Herath is brought back into the attack.
Pitched on leg, turns it 'round the corner and retains strike.
FOUR! The Indian batsmen, in particular Cheteshwar Pujara, has used his feet well so far. Excellent shot. Got to the pitch in a jiffy and wristed it between mid on and mid-wicket for a boundary.
Slaps this to long on off the back foot and fetches himself a single.
Half-tracker on middle, Pujara pulls this hard to deep mid-wicket. Kusal Mendis at short leg just about manages to evade. He's in the firing line for sure.
Tossed up on the pads, slightly quicker in pace, Rahane clips it through the right of short leg and gets off strike.
Floats it across Rahane, who is well forward to defend it.
Flat ball on the stumps, dropped in front of short leg and that will be the end of the over.
Pushed away off the front foot to mid off and takes a brisk run.
Short in length again, Rahane goes back and punches it to extra cover. Wanted the run but seeing Chandimal get to the ball quickly, decided against it.
Worked away on the leg side. Dot ball.
There are a few clouds building on top. The groundsmen have taken their position and this is not a good sign.
FOUR! Sweet timing, beautiful to see. Ajinkya Rahane with a shimmy down the ground just pushes it past Herath at mid off and gets a boundary to his name.
Short, quick and around off, Rahane keeps it out off the back foot.
Too short and no turn at all, easy enough for Jinx to work it away on the leg side for one.
Stays leg sidish, drives it to long on. Single taken.
Tad short, whipped away on the leg side for a single.
Works it with the spin and tries to beat short leg. But the fielder is agile enough to not let it get too far away. Saves a single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.
Starts off from around the wicket, it's going across Rahane who does well to lean across and keep it down on the ground.
Dhananjaya de Silva will bowl for the first time today. A slip and a short leg in place.
Flat and outside off, punched off the back foot through to sweeper cover for a single.
Driven through the mid on region. One run added to the total.
Much like Che, Rahane eases it through mid on and rotates strike.
Advances down the track to this floated ball and wrists it to long on. Single taken.
FOUR! Good timing. Met the ball well at its pitch and drove it through the line past the sliding mid off fielder, who couldn't stop it moving to his left. Super shot.
Off spinner on middle and off, Pujara defends off the inner half in front of FSL.
Looped up close to off, Rahane plants his front foot forward and negotiates it well.
Waits for the ball to come to him, stays back and taps it to point for a single.
SIX! Wrong line and length to bowl. Very wrong. Malinda drops it short, on middle and leg, Pujara rocks back and with a powerful pull clears mid-wicket for a maximum.
Flatter this time, punched down the ground to long off for one run.

Tossed up outside off from around the wicket, Rahane comes ahead and pushes it back down the track.
A slight halt in play as some of the senior players, in a sense, offer words of advice to Pushpakumara. Good to see.

Works it off his pads and places it into the gap on the on side for a couple.
The batsman dances down the track and does well to block the ball.
Against the spin this time. Dances down, close to the pitch and drives it through extra cover for a double.
On leg stump line, Rahane uses the line and the spin to clip it past leg slip for a run.
16th Test fifty for Cheteshwar Pujara, his first against Sri Lanka.
Fifty for Pujara! Another solid knock, but he must continue on and score a big one. He plays with the spin and tucks it past short leg for one.
FOUR! Little short from Malinda and that's enough for Rahane to put it away. He goes back, swivels and pulls it through mid-wicket to send it across the rope.
Beautifully flicks it through the gap in the mid-wicket region and picks up three.
Makes use of his feet but isn't quite close to the pitch, gets hit on the thigh pad as he attempts to get some bat on it.
Pujara has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Presses forward to this full ball and buries it into the track.
Fullish in length, around off, blocked.
FOUR! That's a lovely shot. Rahane is not afraid to take the attack to the opposition. Skips out watching the flight and lifts it over mid-wicket for a boundary.

Dances down the track to negotiate the spin and defends it out with the full face.
Picks it off his pads and flicks it away on the leg side.

Wrists it through the mid-wicket region and picks up a couple of runs for doing so.

Takes a stride forward yet again and deals with it well.
Slower through the air and full on off, Rahane comes ahead and meets it at its pitch.

Drinks are on the field! Sri Lanka have come back into the game by using the conditions well. Picked up a couple of wickets and clogged the run flow effectively. This next phase of play will be quite important for both teams.

He fails to covert it big once again. He is run out for the first time in his Test career. Also, make it 5 out of 7 now - Another time where he's been dismissed on a score between 50-70. Despite the loss of Shikhar Dhawan early in the morning, this is still India's session. Scored 101 runs in 28 overs as Rahul and Pujara have done well with the bat. Kept the scoreboard ticking and the former has gone on to score a fifty. Sri Lanka couldn't do much in this session but the ball is already turning and this will surely encourage them. The afternoon session should make for an interesting viewing. Join us back shortly for that.

A bit of drama just at the stroke of the break. Dilruwan gets a lot of grip off the surface and it spins in with some extra bounce. Takes Pujara by surprise and it goes off the glove behind to leg slip on the bounce. Interesting stuff, he manages to survive. That will be LUNCH ON DAY 1!
Good amount of turn for Dilruwan. Lands it around off, turns and raps Pujara on the thigh pad. Nothing he could do about that.
Use of the feet again, close to the pitch and worked to mid-wicket.
Drags his length back, gives Pujara time to get back and work it away with the spin on the leg side.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Bit fullish in length, outside off, Pujara is behind in defense.
Dilruwan Perera comes back into the attack.
Hangs inside his crease and keeps it out off the back foot.
8th Test fifty for KL Rahul! This is his 6th consecutive fifty. But, 4 out of those 6 times he's gotten out in the 50-70 range. Something to be careful about.
FOUR! That's just adding to Lanka's woes. Rahul advances down the track and lofts it over mid off. It falls just inside the rope and that'll be a boundary.

NOT OUT! RAHUL LIVES TO FIGHT ON! But an excellent delivery from Herath and equally impressive glovework from Niroshan Dickwella. Slightly quicker through the air, turns and beats the outside edge of Rahul's hanging bat. He's a touch off balance too and this provides Dickwella the opportunity to whip the bails off and does so in a flash. It's taken upstairs and replays show that he's done well not to lift his back leg despite the unwanted shift in his balance. Credit to him for that.
Stumping appeal! This could be a big wicket for Sri Lanka. KL Rahul is the man in question. Dickwella could have got his man.
Non-threatening delivery outside off, turning away, Rahul lets it be.
Bit quicker outside off, KL is back in defense.
Drifting in on middle and leg, defended off the inner half on the on side.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Sharp delivery! Landed on a length around off, cuts back in sharply and catches Pujara high on the back thigh. Excellent ball, didn't leave the batsman any chance to play that.
Full outside off, driven tamely towards mid off.
Short of a length delivery, solid defensive shot presented by Pujara.
There is a leg gully in place for Pujara. He got out in that position in the second innings of the last game.
Slightly ahead of a length, stump-to-stump line, worked away with the wrists into the leg side.
Good length delivery seaming back in, Rahul plays from his crease as he gets an inside edge to square leg. Single taken.
Flighted full and attacking the stumps, Pujara takes big lunge forward and defends it on the on side.

Inside edge on that? Simon Doull on air most definitely thinks so. And he's right too, replays confirm there was some bat. Great eye, Simon. Slider on leg, Pujara looks to flick but gets an inside edge off his pads and it flies past a diving Mendis at short leg. Wasn't too far away, that.
On the fuller side once more, Che takes a big stride forward and defends.

Jumps down the wicket, gets close to the pitch of the ball and drives it to mid off for a quick single.
Darts it extremely full outside off, KL stays grounded and dig it out on the off side.
Fraction straight in line, Cheteshwar flicks it a bit uppishly but it's well short of the mid-wicket fielder.
Short of a good length outside off, there was some room but not enough. Pujara attempts to cut and gets a bottom edge as the ball falls on the off side.
Shaping back in on middle and leg, works it around his hips as he tucks it through backward square leg. Comfortable single taken.
In the channel outside off, left alone for the keeper to collect.
Brings out the short one and bangs it in hard, Rahul ducks and evades watchfully.
Back of a length outside off, punched from the crease to covers for no run.
Tossed up delivery on the stumps, a solid front foot block from the batsman and that will be the end of the over.
Drifting in on the pads, worked away down to short fine leg. No run taken.
Quite full, the batsman in well forward as he meets it with the full face of the bat.
Picks it off his pads and turns it against the spin on the leg side.
Slower outside off, turning away as Che taps it square on the off side. Rahul wants the run but Pujara declines.

Excellent over. Maiden. Rahul plants his front foot forward to this full ball and pushes it back down the track.

Keeps it close to the off stick, Rahul gets an inside edge past the leg stump towards short fine leg as he attempts to block.
On the fourth stump line, a good length delivery and it's punched to mid off from the back foot.
Slipped down the leg side, KL looks to get something on it but misses.
Length ball just outside off, defends it in front of mid-wicket off the inner half.

Ripper from Rangi! Absolute peach. Drops it just outside off, a bit short too. Pujara hangs his bat out to defend but it turns ever so slightly and beats the outside edge. Excellent end to the over from the veteran.
Too short from Herath, allows Pujara time to go back and play this very late. Dabbed past the only slip fielder and two runs are in the bag.

Pushed through quicker outside off, with an angled bat it's played to point.
Landed on a driving length, Pujara is down the track as he pushes this to mid off.

Poor Kusal Mendis! That has got to hurt, blow on the helmet is never good. Pujara goes back and smashes the pull straight at Mendis positioned at short leg. The youngster turns to avoid it but is struck on the side of his helmet. The ball lobs back and falls just short of the fielder at mid-wicket. Mendis has his helmet off and fortunately, looks okay to continue. Has a big smile on his face. Good to see.
Swept away on the leg side for no run.
Goes deep inside his crease, waits for the flat ball to come to him and works it past short leg.

Quite full on off, comes well forward and defends.

Spinning away from around off, left alone for the keeper.
Stays back and punches it wide of the cover fielder for a quick run.
Drops it just back of a driving length, Pujara is half-forward to defend but the ball just spins away slightly. Takes the edge and falls into the off side.
FOUR! Short and flat on the stumps, Rahul goes back and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
The batsman drives the ball straight down the ground.
Floated around off, Rahul gets close to the pitch by using his feet and pushes it to the left of the bowler, who makes a tumbling stop.
Positions himself perfectly behind the line and keeps it out.
Touch short again, outside off, Rahul hangs back and blocks.
Stays back to this flatter ball and keeps it out off the back foot.
Defends it in front of short mid-wicket to end the over.
Flat and short outside off, punched off the back foot through covers for one.

Harsha Bhogle on air has some good insight on Hardik Pandya. He says that he definitely has the potential, but it's too soon to compare him to Ben Stokes just yet. Hardik has just played 18 first-class matches whereas Stokes had 50-plus already under his belt before breaking out onto the scene. So India must really invest in him and give him time, as he could be a vital cog in this Indian Test team for a long time.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Takes a step out of the crease seeing the flight and works it past the man at short leg.
Not much spin on this occasion, going on straight, Pujara defends it off the inner half from within his crease.
Tossed up well outside off, Rahul reaches for it a bit and pushes it straight towards extra cover for a run.
Rangana Herath is back into the attack.
Makes use of his feet again, comes down the track and whips it through the mid-wicket region for a couple of runs.
Nice drift into Cheteshwar Pujara, slow and on the stumps, Pujara brings his bat ahead of his pad and deals with it well.
Skips down and pushes it to mid on.
Takes it on the full and sweeps it down towards fine leg for an easy run.
Loopy and full on middle and leg, Rahul clears his front leg and drives it hard back down the track. The bowler makes a half-stop towards mid on, nicely done. The batsmen don't take a run.
FOUR! Malinda gives it a lot of flight and seeing this, Rahul uses his feet well. Gets to the pitch and lofts it over extra cover for a boundary.
Bowls it way outside off, Pujara pads it away. There is a mild appeal from Dickwella but nothing from the umpire.
Flatter outside off, Pujara cuts it towards point.
FOUR! TOP SHOT! He loves using his feet to the finger spinner. Dances down the track and drives it past the bowler for a boundary.
Drags his length back outside off, Pujara guides it towards the vacant point region and takes two.
Dances down the track and flicks it to mid on. Pujara sets off for a run but then sends his partner back.
Plays it with the spin towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Drinks break! India started off well but the Lankans have come back with Dhawan's dismissal. A wicket or two now and they present themselves with the opportunity to have a firm position in this game.
Tosses it on middle, Pujara plants his front foot forward and defends it.
Gives it air on middle, Pujara defends it watchfully.
Loopy ball on middle, the batsman defends it by covering the line of the ball.
Flighted ball on off, Pujara defends it off the front foot.
Comes down the track and inside edges it towards mid-wicket who fumbles and concedes a run.
Tosses it up on off, Rahul defends it off the back foot.

Another change from Chandimal, he's mixing it up. Debutant Malinda Pushpakumara will bowl for the very first time in his international career. He has 558 wickets in 99 first-class matches, not an easy feat to achieve. One wonders why he's coming into the national team so late. Let's see how he fares on the big stage. There is a slip and a short leg in place.
Dances down the track and drives it to mid off.
Flatter outside off, Pujara pads it away.
Comes down the track and drives it to mid off.
Plays it with the spin towards the leg side for a run.
Taps it in front of cover-point and Pujara sets off for a run. The fielder is quick to the ball and has a shy at the striker's end but misses. A single taken.

JUST SHORT! Tosses it up outside off, Pujara plays for the spin but the ball goes on with the arm and he gets an outside edge towards Mathews at first slip. He dives to his right and the ball falls just short of him. He makes a half stop and the ball rolls towards short third man. Pujara wants a single but is sent back by Rahul.
Good length on off, Rahul defends it off the back foot.
Sprays on the pads, Rahul flicks it through the leg side for a couple.
Just ahead of a length on off, Lokesh drives it towards mid off.
Angles it into the batsman, Rahul works it to mid-wicket.
Bowled on middle, Rahul defends it by covering the line of the ball.
Lands it on a length on off, Rahul gets it off the inner half back to the bowler.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Plays it with the spin towards square leg for a run.
Almost an edge there! Flatter outside off, Rahul tries to cut but gets beaten.
Loopy ball on off, Rahul defends it off the front foot.
Flighted ball on off, Pujara gets it off the outside edge towards short third man for a run.
Cheteshwar Pujara, who is playing his 50th Test, makes his way out into the middle. Special occasion for him, he'll look to make it count like he usually does.

OUT! A successful review from Sri Lanka this time. The bowling change has worked wonders. The dangerman Dhawan has to depart. Bowls it full on middle, the ball straightens a little. Dhawan tries to sweep but misses and is struck on the pads. The Lankans appeal and this time the umpire gives it not out. Dickwella wants it to be reviewed straightaway and Chandimal obliges and reviews. They go upstairs. Replays show that there was no bat involved. The ball has pitched in line, strikes him in line and is hitting the leg stump. Three reds the umpire has to overturn his decision again. Big wicket for the home side. Dilruwan is ecstatic.
Another lbw shout, this time Dhawan is the man in question. Looks close, he could be in trouble.
Dilruwan Perera will have a go with the ball.
A tad fuller on off, Shikhar drives it towards sweeper cover and takes a single.
Sprays on the pads, Rahul flicks it to fine leg for a run.
A tad fuller outside off, Dhawan pushes it through covers for a run.
Drifts it on the pads, Rahul flicks it through square leg and rotates strike.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.

NOT OUT! Rahul survives. A brilliant review from him. The ploy to bowl with the part timer almost paid off for Sri Lanka. Bowls it on a length on middle, jags back in a touch. Rahul tries to flick but misses and is struck on the pads. The Lankans appeal and the umpire gives it out. Lokesh walks down to his partner and after a chat he decides to review it. They go upstairs. Replays show that the ball has pitched in line and hits him in line but is missing the stumps. The on-field call has to be overturned. Rahul will breathe a sigh of a relief.
Rahul has taken a review as he has been adjudged LBW. Looks close!
Fuller on middle, Dhawan drives it to mid off.
Good length on off, Rahul taps it in front of covers and runs a single.

FOUR! It is raining boundaries in Colombo. Bowls it on the pads, Rahul flicks it to the fine leg fence for a boundary. The 50 is up for India, first 50-plus opening stand for them against the Lankan in the last 10 innings.
Bangs it in short this time, Shikhar pulls it through backward square leg for a run.
FOUR! He is so good through the cover region. Full outside off, Dhawan drives it through covers for another boundary. He is on the charge here.
Change of angle from Pradeep, comes over the wicket to Dhawan. Bowls it wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
Good length on off, Rahul defends it by covering the line of the ball.
Fullish length outside off, Dhawan drives it through covers for a run.
A tad fuller on middle, gets some sharp movement back into the batsman. Dhawan tries to flick but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
A tad shorter outside off, Rahul punches it through covers and the batsmen run three. India are off to a flier here.
Lands it on a length on off, Lokesh defends it solidly.
Good length on off, Rahul defends it off the back foot.
An unlikely bowling change as Dimuth Karunaratne is introduced into the bowling attack.

BIG APPEAL! But nothing from the umpire. Lands it on a length on middle, Dhawan walks across and tries to flick but misses and is struck on the pads. Appeal made but seems like it was going down the leg side.
Full on off, Dhawan lunges forward and drives it through extra cover. The fielder from mid off gives chase and does well to stop the ball before the boundary. Two taken from the batsmen.
Shorter in length on off, Dhawan pushes it towards point.

Sri Lanka are already pegged on the back foot. There was a long leg, deep mid-wicket and long on in place in one of his earlier overs. Now, in Pradeep's, there's a deep point and gully has been removed. The Dhawan effect for you, people!
Good length on off, Dhawan defends it by covering the line of the ball.
Back of a length on off, Shikhar defends it off the back foot.
FOUR! CRACKING SHOT! He is growing in confidence here. Fuller in length outside off, Dhawan leans forward and drives it through covers and the ball races to the fence.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Rahul. Dances down the track and hits it towards mid off where Karunaratne slips while running to his left and lets it through for another boundary.
FOUR! TOP SHOT! Herath gives it air outside off, Rahul square drives it for a boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
A tad shorter on middle, Rahul flicks it towards short leg who makes a good reflex stop.
Floats it on middle, Rahul defends it solidly. He is more comfortable bowling to the right-hander.
Tosses it up on middle, Dhawan drives it to long on for a run.

Lands it on a length on middle, jags back in a touch. Rahul tries to work it on the leg side but gets an inside edge onto the pads. There is a stifled appeal from the Lankans but nothing from the umpire.
Fullish outside off, Dhawan drives it powerfully towards mid off who half stops it and the batsmen take a single.
A tad fuller on off, Dhawan drives it to mid off.
FOUR! CRUNCHED! Bangs it in short on middle, Dhawan pulls it through square leg for a boundary. That made a cracking sound off the bat.
Good length outside off, Dhawan pushes it off the inner half to mid off.
Lands it on a length outside off, does not fiddle with it.
Floats it on off, Rahul pushes it to mid on. A maiden by Herath.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground
Drags his length back outside off, Lokesh cuts it towards point where de Silva dives to his left and makes a good stop.
Flatter on off, Rahul pushes it back to the bowler.
Dances down the track and flicks it to mid-wicket.
CLOSE SHAVE! Loopy ball around off, goes on with the arm. Lokesh lets it through to the keeper. The ball just misses the off pole. A brave leave from Rahul there.
Back of a length on off, Dhawan pushes it to point. Dhawan is playing with a positive intent just like he played in the first innings of the first Test.
FOUR! Nails the cut shot this time. Shorter outside off, Shikhar camps back and cuts it through backward point for a boundary.
BEATEN! Just ahead of a length outside off, Dhawan tries to cut but gets beaten. That was a bit too full to cut.
Back of a length on off, the batsman pushes it to covers.
A tad fuller outside off, Dhawan shoulders his arms to it.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
The last shot made Chandimal take push mid on back. Dhawan pushes it there and takes a run.
SIX! BANG! We saw this so many times in the first Test. Dances down the wicket and lofts it over the long on fence for a maximum. Brilliant from Dhawan.
Drags his length back outside off, Shikhar cuts it to point.
EDGED BUT SHORT! Dhawan is living dangerously here. Flighted ball outside off, Dhawan pokes at it but gets an outside edge which falls just short of first slip.
Tosses it up on middle, Rahul defends it off the front foot.
Floats it on middle, gets some drift into the batsman. Rahul gets it off the inner half through backward square leg for a couple. That was loose from Rahul.
Well, well, well... What do we have here? Spin right from the off. Rangana Herath will be bowling from the other end. A slip and a short leg in position for him.

FOUR! STREAKY BOUNDARY! Lands it on a length just outside off, Dhawan pokes at it and gets an outside edge past the diving third slip fielder for a boundary. The slip should have been a little closer. A good over by Pradeep.
Lands it on a length outside off, Shikhar does not fiddle with it.
Good length on off, Dhawan defends it solidly off the back foot.
Bowls it way wide outside off, Dhawan points his bat skywards and lets it through to the keeper. Pradeep should be bowling a little straighter.
A tad fuller outside off, Dhawan does not bother playing a shot at it.
Comes around the wicket. Starts off with a length ball outside off, Dhawan shoulders his arms to it.

We are ready to get underway. The players and the umpires are out in the middle. Shikhar Dhawan and Lokesh Rahul will open the batting for India. Nuwan Pradeep will bowl the first over for Sri Lanka. Three slips in a gully in place. Here we go...

Dinesh Chandimal says he feels much better and has recovered now well from the pneumonia. States despite the loss in Galle, you have to take the positives out of it. Stresses the importance scoring big runs after getting starts like Shikhar Dhawan did and the bowlers need to stick to their plans. Adds it's a dry surface so wants to keep the Indians to as low a score as possible. Mentions there are three changes - himself, Malinda Pushpakumara (debut) and Dhananjaya de Silva come in for Danushka Gunathilaka, Asela Gunaratne (injured) and Lahiru Kumara.

Virat Kohli says it feels good to win the toss and they will bat first. He reckons it will be a good wicket. He opines he wants to make good use of the wicket by batting first. He admits that they have recovered well and understands the importance of rest too. He further adds they are well prepared for this game. Informs that Lokesh Rahul comes in place of Abhinav Mukund. Finishes by saying Lokesh Rahul has been their champion opener and Abhinav Mukund understands the dynamics of how a team works.

TOSS - INDIA WIN THE TOSS AND ELECT TO BAT FIRST! A bit of trivia. This is the first toss Sri Lanka have lost here after 10 consecutive matches. And, Virat Kohli has never lost a Test match after winning the toss.

Pitch Report - Russel Arnold says the sun should break through and there should be a cool breeze coming through. Mentions that when comparing the wicket to the Sri Lanka-Australia game last year, it's less drier. Adds the team winning the toss should bat first. Continues saying when the ball starts landing in the line of the stumps, there will be movement and cheeky batsmen running down the wicket will only aid that. Ends the pitch report expecting lots of runs on the first day.

India on the other hand, could not have asked for a better way to start the tour. They will be oozing with confidence and Virat Kohli would want the winning momentum to continue. It will be interesting to see if Kuldeep Yadav gets a game on a track which will assist the spinners and if Abhinav Mukund keeps his place. We are in for an exciting day of cricket. Stay tuned for the toss which might play an important factor in this game.

Hello and welcome to the 2nd Test between Sri Lanka and India in Colombo. We will have to wait and watch whether the hosts have recovered from the drubbing they received in the series opener. They have been handed a boost with the return of their of their skipper Dinesh Chandimal who missed the first game due to illness. Also, Rangana Herath has been passed fit to play. The home side will have to play out of its skin to have any chance of leveling the series.
